PHL_ESG_CSR_048.scope: Publicly listed companies; sustainability template accompanies SEC Form17-A, comply-or-explain transition does not remove the attachment duty.
PHL_ESG_CSR_048.timing: SEC MC4 dated15Feb2019; first annual report forFY2019 submitted2020. No issuer-specific observed filing supplied.
PHL_ESG_CSR_048.locator: Circular page1 and item3, first report; publication/effectivity note.

IRL_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0019.scope: SI560/2016 Reg3(2) exempts regulated-market-listed companies and entities subject to equivalent ownership-transparency standards. Listing venue must be matched.
IRL_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0019.timing: Internal register commences15Nov2016. It is distinct from central filing in2019.

IRL_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0035.scope: SI110/2019 Reg4(2) preserves regulated-market/equivalent-transparency exemption. Domestic incorporation and listing category required.
IRL_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0035.timing: Part3 commences22Jun2019; incumbent central filing within5months (22Nov2019). New entities within5months of incorporation. Deadline is not observed filing.

IRL_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0038.scope: General public access restriction changes access, not first existence of the register.
IRL_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0038.timing: SI308/2023 removes general public access; retain as access amendment rather than a new adoption.
IRL_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0038.locator: Amendments to SI110/2019 central-register access provisions.

FRA_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0020.scope: Decree supplies registration procedure; historical statutory listed-company exemption still requires separate statute verification and venue matching.
FRA_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0020.timing: Decree2017-1094 effective1Aug2017; incumbent transition before1Apr2018, new registrations follow R561-55. No uniform actual filing date.
FRA_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0020.locator: Notice of entry into force; Article1 R561-55; Article2.

ZAF_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0025.scope: Affected/listed companies have securities-register obligations distinct from other-company beneficial-owner registers. Do not blanket-treat every listed quote.
ZAF_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0025.timing: Official CIPC account distinguishes voluntary1Apr2023 launch from mandatory24May2023; later annual-return enforcement is separate.
ZAF_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_0025.locator: Official Beneficial Ownership page, launch/mandatory filing and affected-company explanations.

IND_AUDIT_REPORTING_0101.scope: SA701 listed-entity auditor report; no revenue or employment threshold inferred.
IND_AUDIT_REPORTING_0101.timing: Official ICAI branch newsletter confirms deferral to periods beginning1Apr2018, not public filings on that day. Original standard remains a source-quality limitation.
IND_AUDIT_REPORTING_0101.locator: December2017 EIRC newsletter, page3, SA701 deferral.

USA_AUDIT_REPORTING_0102.scope: Large accelerated filers, excluding EGCs; broker/dealer, investment-company and employee-plan exceptions require entity-specific checks. BDCs are not automatically investment-company-exempt.
USA_AUDIT_REPORTING_0102.timing: Fiscal years ending on/after30Jun2019. Join actual SEC filing date; do not assign all USA quotes2019.
USA_AUDIT_REPORTING_0102.locator: Guidance page8, EffectiveDates; CAM exception paragraph.

USA_AUDIT_REPORTING_0103.scope: Remaining eligible non-EGC companies; categories and legal-class exceptions must be observed.
USA_AUDIT_REPORTING_0103.timing: Fiscal years ending on/after15Dec2020. A Dec2020 year-end usually first files in2021; actual date from SEC header.
USA_AUDIT_REPORTING_0103.locator: Guidance page8, EffectiveDates; CAM exception paragraph.

USA_AUDIT_OVERSIGHT_0133.scope: SOX section102 is auditor registration, not an issuer disclosure threshold.
USA_AUDIT_OVERSIGHT_0133.timing: Act ties deadline to180days after SEC determination; Act alone does not establish the recorded22Oct2003 calendar deadline. Exact decision history remains unresolved.

SGP_AUDIT_OVERSIGHT_0136.scope: Institutional ACRA oversight; issuer first-filing field is not applicable to the institution-creation event.
SGP_AUDIT_OVERSIGHT_0136.timing: Official ACRA history confirms establishment1Apr2004 by RCB/PAB merger.

AUS_SUPPLY_CHAIN_0156.scope: Section5: at leastAUD100m consolidated revenue and Australian entity/carrying on business inAustralia; voluntary reporters separate. Dictionary revenue alone does not establish scope.
AUS_SUPPLY_CHAIN_0156.timing: Operative provisions commence1Jan2019. Section13(2)(e) gives6months after reporting period; historical pandemic extensions not replaced by that ordinary deadline. Actual statements remain unlinked.
